title: GUI Retextures Mod Support
description: Mod support for the GUI Retextures pack
body:
This add-on pack adds support for some mods to [GUI Retextures](/resourcepack/gui-retextures)!

![A showcase of the resource pack applied to UI elements from Traveller's Backpacks, Enchancement, and Appleskin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6e69dcd7f958a9352a6022e4206381572dc0204.png)

Mods supported include:
- Appleskin
- Armor Points ++
- Backpacked
- Backslot
- Baubles
- Bedrockify
- Conveniently Placed Armor Slots
- Curios
- EMI
- Enchancement
- Entity Texture/Model Features
- Extra Armour Info
- INMIS
- InventoryHUD
- Mantle
- Polymorph
- Replay Mod
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- Speed Trading
- Toughness Bar
- Traveller's Backpack
- Trinkets
